title: .DOT
tagline: SMALL APPS IN LED DOTS, MADE TO WORK TOGETHER
intro: The Dot apps are a family of Android apps drawn in amber LED dots. Each one does one thing well and works offline; together they take an idea from a beat to a finished song, from a photo to your home screen. No accounts, no ads, no AI.

flows.title: FROM BEAT TO SONG
flows.about: Make a beat, write to it, record it, put it out.

steps.what: Build a beat on the pads and chain patterns A, B, C… into a song.
.CAPTURE ▸ drops the beat on your notebook page, looping, while you write the lyrics.
.STUDIO ▸ opens the song in .Studio, already cut into its parts. Record each section, clean it up, mix.
MAKE VIDEO turns the song into a lyric video with your pictures.
SEND TO CAPTURE puts the finished song back on a song sheet, with the mix as a player.

flows.title: FROM PHOTO TO EVERYWHERE
flows.about: Shoot, edit, and send the picture where it's needed.

steps.what: Take the photo with rangefinder framelines and the LED dot look.
EDIT opens it in .Editor: light, colour, film filters, crop, LED dots, a stamp.
SEND hands it straight to the app you choose:
a new notebook page, or a magazine layout,
the picture behind a song's lyric video,
a full-screen LED picture on your home screen,

flows.title: BATTLE A FRIEND
flows.about: A freestyle or graffiti battle, sent as a file.

steps.what: Make a beat (or use one of .BattleWall's own).
Write a verse one line per bar and rap it, or paint a piece that moves on the beat.
SEND CHALLENGE: your friend answers on their phone and sends it back. Watch both rounds, pick who won, export the video.

apps.name: .BEATPAD
apps.about: A beat maker with 16 pads, a step sequencer and eight patterns that chain into a song. Kits from classic drums to hand drums and a hang, synths, your own samples, piano and guitar on any pad, and lessons that build a groove layer by layer.
features: 16 pads, step sequencer, patterns A–H and a song line
Kits, synths, samples, piano and guitar sounds
Mix: echo, reverb, filter, drive
Learn: drum lessons and Build a beat
MIDI controllers
Send to .Studio, .Capture and .BattleWall; save WAV or stems

apps.name: .STUDIO
apps.about: A pocket recording studio. Bring in a beat, write the lyrics one line per bar and record rap or singing section by section, with the bars, the beat and the section you're in always on screen. Then make a lyric video of the song.
features: Sections with their own takes; pick the best one
Count-in, teleprompter, level meter and live waveform
CLEAN UP takes out room hiss; SYNC nudges a take
Mix and export WAV or M4A
Lyric videos: LED, karaoke or big type over your pictures, 1080p or 720p

apps.name: .CAPTURE
apps.about: A paper notebook on your phone: type anywhere, draw over it, turn the page. Song sheets with chords, sections and alternative lyrics; magazine pages for photo stories; a project board. This website is published from it.
features: Type anywhere, draw, pictures, voice notes
Song sheets: chords, sections, song details, alternative lyrics
Beats on the page, looping while you write
Photo magazine layouts
Export PDF or text, share pages, back up
Publish pages to your own website

apps.name: .BATTLEWALL
apps.about: Freestyle and graffiti battles with friends. Write a verse and rap it while the LED wall sprays it bar by bar, or paint a messy animated piece on the wall. Funny scenes for every genre, and a video to share at the end.
features: Freestyle Battle: write, rap, sprayed bar by bar
Graffiti Battle: spray cans, drips, frames that move on the beat
Challenges as files: no account needed
Scenes and beats for six genres
1080 × 1920 video export

apps.name: .BOOMBOX
apps.about: A music player that looks like the nineties: skinned windows, an equaliser, a playlist, visualizers and classic skins. Internet radio, your own music, Bandcamp and music servers, and scratch decks for fun.
features: LED and classic .wsz skins
Internet radio with thousands of stations
Visualizers, including Milkdrop-style presets
Bandcamp and Subsonic servers
Scratch decks and MIDI controllers

apps.name: .FINDER
apps.about: A camera with rangefinder bright-line frames for 35 and 50 mm, manual controls and a live LED dot look. Each photo can carry the place and the temperature.
features: 35 / 50 mm framelines
Manual focus with peaking, double exposure, long exposure
Live LED dot filter for photos and video
Place and temperature saved in the photo
EDIT opens the shot in .Editor

apps.name: .EDITOR
apps.about: A photo editor with film-style filters, a colour mixer and grading wheels, crop and cinema bars, and the LED dot look. SEND hands the finished photo to any Dot app.
features: Light, colour, effects and grading
Ten film filters and your own
Crop, straighten, cinema bars
LED dots and a photo stamp
SEND to .Capture, .Studio, .WallPaper, .BattleWall

apps.name: .WALLPAPER
apps.about: A live wallpaper that turns your phone's screen into an LED dot board: clock, weather, calendar, music, games and your own pictures, in layouts that change through the day.
features: Layouts with clock, weather, calendar and more
Rotate layouts or change them by time
Picture studio: your photos as LEDs
Snake and other little games
Charging lightning, notification light, screen saver

apps.name: .CALCULATOR
apps.about: An everyday calculator laid out like your phone's own, drawn as an LED board, with unit and currency converters and tools for beat makers.
features: The usual layout, live result, history
Currency with crypto, length, area, weight and more
Tap tempo, delay times, tempo shift, song length, note ↔ Hz
Colour skins
